extraction.Name: Ada McCloskey
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by R. E. Wang
extraction.Buyer: Ada McCloskey Whipple and John Whipple conveyed the land to Albert Nelson for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612439 issued; southeast quarter of section 11, township 37, range 25; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 20, 1918; land was mortgaged for $1500.00; on December 21, 1918 Ada McCloskey Whipple and John Whipple conveyed the land to Albert Nelson for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
